prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone MEDIUM illustration for an AI reasoning engine website: an elegant holographic technical schematic of a mechanical engine with a translucent human brain overlapping it. Three-quarter isometric view. A compact turbine-like computational engine core, two concentric rotor rings and a few carefully chosen technical construction lines, rendered in precise blue and silver-blue wireframe. A ghosted brain volume floats halfway through the upper engine assembly, with readable curved brain folds visibly crossing and overlapping the mechanical blueprint, making the two layered forms distinct yet unified. The brain is also holographic wireframe, not flesh and not solid chrome. Fine luminous cobalt and ice-blue strokes, selective depth, sparse diagrammatic detailing, minimalist premium engineering visualization. No typography or annotations. Centered isolated subject, generous negative space, transparent background, square composition, intended 280–400px display on a pale cool-gray interface. Keep outer contours strong and inner lines restrained. No card, enclosing panel, solid metal lobes, pedestal, realistic car engine, smoke, dense HUD, background grid, or extra floating symbols.
open_questions: Does this illustration communicate reasoning support clearly to new readers?
